comparison.objective: Damper commissioning versus supporting a bar while withdrawing its carriage and storing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated fine adjustment and iterative impact testing versus continuous load support and controlled lowering.
comparison.success_condition: Non-bottoming repeatable stops versus no drop or excessive tilt during carriage removal.
comparison.reason: Tests setting calibration rather than support during fixture withdrawal. Exact bar thresholds are deferred outside the body and specs are empty.
